name: Forsaken Diseases
summary: In eastern Ashenvale, Kayneth Stillwind watches the Forsaken draw nearer. He fears they are brewing blights to ravage sacred elven lands, and sends Alliance champions toward a camp near Dor'Danil Barrow Den to seize a sample.

sections.title: A Plague on the Forests
sections.body: Ashenvale's night elves have long faced satyrs, raging elementals, and orcish logging crews. The Forsaken bring a darker threat. The undead arm of the Horde is taking root near ancient ruins and sacred barrow dens. Their presence brings war and the fear of alchemical plague spreading through Kaldorei groves.

sections.title: Infiltration at Dor'Danil
sections.body: South of Forest Song, near Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Forsaken apothecaries and scouts have fortified a camp. They bottle untested toxins among brewing caldrons and foul reagents. Kayneth Stillwind sends scouts inside to recover an intact Bottle of Disease, so its volatile contents can be studied before the Forsaken unleash it across the forest.

faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind is a night elf keeping watch from the ruins of Forest Song in eastern Ashenvale. He tracks hostile movements across the region, especially the Forsaken and corrupting influences near the barrow dens.

faq.q: Where is the Forsaken camp located?
faq.answer: The Forsaken camp lies south of Forest Song, near Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Their forces have gathered around brewing tables and tents to concoct biological mixtures.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Forsaken pursue alchemical and biological aims in Ashenvale. Near ancient Kaldorei barrows, they gather reagents and brew toxic compounds, leading the elves to fear they mean to infect the land.

faq.q: What happens after retrieving the bottle?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind examines the captured bottle to identify its contents. His investigation leads to the plight of sleeping druids inside nearby Dor'Danil Barrow Den, and he turns to that danger next.

Forest Song is an ancient, nearly abandoned night elf ruin in far eastern Ashenvale, near the border of Azshara. Kayneth Stillwind lives there alone and directs the fight against the Forsaken in the region.

faq.q: What are the barrow dens in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Barrow dens are sacred underground sanctuaries where night elf druids sleep in communion with the Emerald Dream. Dor'Danil Barrow Den is one such site, making the Forsaken camp nearby a grave concern for the Kaldorei.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, the undead presence near a sacred barrow den is an intolerable desecration. Defending the sleeping druids and Ashenvale from vile toxins means protecting their survival and honor.
Druids hold the barrow dens sacred as places of communion with the Emerald Dream. Bottled blights near Dor'Danil strike at the heart of the Cenarion Circle's guardianship.
The Horde's Forsaken allies bring chemical warfare to Ashenvale. The threat shows Alliance leaders that the conflict in the forest reaches beyond disputes over wood.
